title: ChatGPT Now Types While You Talk, Free 🎙️
description:
ChatGPT's new Live Dictation turns your speech into text as you talk, and it is rolling out worldwide on every ChatGPT plan, including free. OpenAI also removed the old 10-minute recording limit, and you can edit the text before you send it. It works on the web, the desktop app, iPhone and Android.

Would you rather type or talk to AI? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: OpenAI (@ChatGPT), Live Dictation announcement (November 18, 2026) via Digital Trends and iClarified (November 19, 2026)

#AItools #AInews #Shorts #ChatGPT #VoiceTyping
